logic_errors.description: The publisher sums distinct relativePath values and reports them as uniqueRuntimeImageCount/runtimeTexturePixels/runtimeRgbaBytes. Distinct source filenames are allowed to contain identical pinned PNG bytes; PresentationMediaLibrary instead shares by verified SHA-256, linear-mask/sRGB semantics and dimensions. The publication report therefore overstates retained resource counts and memory for accepted duplicate-content inputs.
logic_errors.fix: Compute reported runtime resource/memory totals from unique (derived SHA-256, mask-vs-face semantics, width, height) keys; optionally expose a separate distinct-runtime-file count. Add the duplicate-content/different-filename regression to AuthoringTests.
logic_errors.impact: Reporting-only correctness defect, not a native cache/budget/publication corruption bug. Actual supplied corpus independently reconciles to 107 unique textures and is unaffected. This blocks an unconditional COMPLETE-tool correctness verdict; it does not negate the existing actual native PASS evidence.
logic_errors.reproduction: Supplemental disposable fixture copied base1-001.png bytes over base1-002.png, updated only that fixture's intake bytes/SHA-256, then called the real prepare API. Publication succeeded with all catalog bindings. The report returned 107 / 51,479,000 pixels / 205,916,000 RGBA bytes; independent grouping using the production cache key returned 106 / 50,984,000 pixels / 203,936,000 bytes.
logic_errors.title: Reported runtime texture totals count paths rather than the media library's verified unique resources

Renderer worker's Phase3MediaHost/Tabletop/shader edits are intentionally outside this freeze. passed:false is solely CORE-01; no security finding and no native-media logic defect was found.

Read all pages of Base_Set_Materials_Contract.md, Materials_Asset_Preparation.md, Materials_Media.md, authoring tool/tests, every in-scope media source, materials runners/native tests, legacy fixture runner and original 13/49 test sources. Large structured manifests/inventories/oracles were fully parsed and every original/derived/binding record reconciled, not approved from excerpts.

Independently read/hash-checked all 114 original files and fully verified/decoded all 110 original PNGs and 110 derived PNGs with installed Pillow. Compared entire top-down RGBA byte arrays, original dimensions, source/derived byte hashes and strict derived IHDR (8-bit RGBA, noninterlaced). Cards/back/holo stay 600x825; wrappers stay 260x475. No resize/crop/repaint/edition-mark removal/color transform was performed or required. Per-image top-down and bottom-up full RGBA SHA-256 are retained in actual_pixel_audit.json.

Exactly 101 unchanged catalog IDs and 15 eligible holo-mask bindings share one base1-foil.png; no nonholo mask, no #8 face/mask/runtime path. Machamp archive derivation remains unbound. Charizard is the single initial front; all three 260x475 fronts remain. Exact role uniqueness and schema fields/hashes reconcile across 121 bindings / 107 unique native-compatible keys / 51,479,000 pixels for the actual corpus. Catalog byte pin and model pin remain unchanged across review. Rights unknown/no redistribution and user-approved first-edition visual substitute for Unlimited identities are preserved honestly; no intrusive edition-warning UI requirement was introduced.

Strict JSON, canonical catalog semantics and exact source inventory/count/lowercase hashes precede derivation. Ancestors are checked root-first; traversal/UNC/device, symlink/junction/reparse and regular-file hardlinks are refused. CLI root is fenced to project/authoring fixtures. Cooperative lock is authoring-artifact-local, exclusive and identity/content checked on removal. Post-decode preflight rehashes source inputs. Foreign/mutated destinations/generations are refused. Complete owned generation is installed before manifest-last atomic publication; first manifest uses no-replace hardlink, update rechecks expected prior bytes before replace. Prior generations remain; orphan complete generations support retry. This is not atomic compare-and-swap against arbitrary external writers, an OS sandbox or a power-loss durability guarantee.

Fresh independent run of the real 18-test AuthoringTests.py suite exited 0, ran 18 tests and reported OK in 27.824 seconds. Fixtures were exclusively below .artifacts/materials-authoring and removed by unittest cleanup; output log is in this report directory. The pure suite re-proved idempotent bytes/mtime, readonly sources, real Windows junction/hardlink refusal, source mutation after decode, CLI and publication failures. Actual-corpus idempotent rerun/mtime proof is separately retained worker evidence (Actual_Verification.json + actual-rerun.log), not a publisher rerun by this reviewer.

IPresentationMedia is unchanged and IWrapperMetallicMedia is separate/optional. Wrapper masks use exact added roles with no cardId; strict unknown/schema/duplicate handling remains. Masks are second-pass and each requires its own successfully decoded, exactly aligned face BEFORE every shared-cache hit. Hash/path/header checks precede reuse. Default remains 16MiPixel; only explicit caller flag selects bounded 64MiPixel, never manifest data. Existing per-file/dimension/entry caps remain.

Native textures share only by verified file digest + mask-linear/face-sRGB semantics + inspected dimensions. Unique resources/pixels are charged once; failed decode is destroyed and not cached/charged; every binding retains provenance and successful binding count. Lookup has no I/O. Ownership list contains resources once; idempotent disposal clears counters and references. Foley synthesis uses local xorshift, creates no AudioSource/playback and has no save/generation/network API. RNG/no-autoplay checks also remain in the 49 native regression suite.

Two reload/dispose records both report 121 bindings, 107 textures, 51,479,000 pixels, 67,108,864-pixel cap, 206,011,872 measured retained native-texture bytes, fullPixelHashBindings:121 and synthetic:false; reference equality, actual native-null destruction, zero counters/no-owned-resource leaks and no AudioSources are asserted. Default actual-set load separately refuses over-budget full coverage. Native report is evidence of real Editor library decoding, NOT player/renderer/human acceptance. WorkingSet unavailable/zero is not a memory-use claim.

This was a reviewer-harness assertion, not a product failure, and verification.json records only its four checked subsets; it is not the overall verdict after supplemental CORE-01.

test_gaps.detail: The 18-test suite assumes distinct-content fixtures for distinct runtime paths; its expected 107 cannot detect CORE-01. Supplemental read-only-to-live-source fixture supplies the missing counterexample.

Verified ordinary first/update manifest failures, prior-content mismatch, late foreign collision and retry preservation. Not an exhaustive OS-failure/power-loss test: failures during initial Owner.json creation, directory rename, lock cleanup, abrupt termination and disk durability are not all fault-injected. Existing documentation correctly disclaims crash-atomic multi-file publication and hostile filesystem race immunity.

Tests exercise readonly file attributes and byte preservation; they do not establish a directory ACL denying all writes. Source inspection confirms no source-side write/lock/chmod, and this review rehashed all 114 originals.

Ignore policy excludes all supplied/source art while allowing the two explicit runtime manifests. Git/index/commit inspection was prohibited, so absence of already tracked or force-staged binaries is NOT independently certified; parent must check its explicit publication/staging set.

No Unity or player process was launched by this reviewer, avoiding the shared stage. Retained source-pinned actual native Editor evidence was reconciled. Deferred play-mode destruction, integrated renderer/host/shaders, pause/mute/playback, candidate build/GUID closure, GPU/player memory, physical hearing and human visual acceptance remain parent gates.

Existing actual run records six installed-library SHA-256 pins and nativeLibrariesUnchanged:true. Root-only review did not access installed binaries outside the project or independently rehash them now.
